title: Rotated Lipschitz graph: closedness and slope bound relative to T_0
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers, q a linear isometry of R^(n+l) onto itself, f : R^n -> R^l and eps >= 0, and suppose f is eps-Lipschitz on all of R^n (LipschitzWith (Real.toNNReal eps) f). Put Fhat := q(graphOver f R^n) = { q(graphPoint u (f u)) : u in R^n }, T_0 := rotatedPlane q = q(R^n x {0}), and let P be the orthogonal projection onto T_0 (T_0.starProjection). Then (a) Fhat is closed in R^(n+l), and (b) |(x - z) - P(x - z)| <= eps |x - z| for all x, z in Fhat.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ) (f : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (ε : ℝ), 0 ≤ ε → LipschitzWith (Real.toNNReal ε) f → IsClosed (q '' graphOver f univ) ∧ ∀ x ∈ q '' graphOver f univ, ∀ z ∈ q '' graphOver f univ, ‖(x - z) - (rotatedPlane q).starProjection (x - z)‖ ≤ ε * ‖x - z‖
